title: Animal 'Facts' Everyone Still Believes (That Are Completely Wrong)

beats.say: Quick quiz. What does an ostrich do when it gets scared?
beats.img: a nervous cartoon ostrich standing in the savanna, sweating

beats.say: If you said it buries its head in the sand, congratulations. You've been lied to by a cartoon.
beats.img: a cartoon ostrich bent over with its whole head buried under a pile of sand so only its fluffy body and long legs are visible

beats.say: Today we're fixing the animal facts that your teacher, your uncle, and the entire internet got completely wrong.
beats.img: a cartoon teacher pointing at a chalkboard covered in animal drawings

beats.say: Let's start with the ostrich. Ostriches do not bury their heads in the sand. Not when they're scared, not ever.
beats.img: a proud cartoon ostrich standing tall with its chest puffed out

beats.say: Think about it. An animal that suffocated itself every time it got nervous would not have survived very long.
beats.img: a cartoon ostrich scratching its head, thinking, with a question mark above it

beats.say: What they actually do is dig a shallow hole in the ground as a nest, and lay their eggs in it.
beats.img: a cartoon ostrich nest dug in the dirt with big white eggs inside

beats.say: Several times a day, they lower their heads into that hole to turn the eggs over.
beats.img: a cartoon ostrich bending its long neck down into a round dirt nest to turn over three big white eggs

beats.say: From far away, it looks like the bird is head first in the dirt. It's not hiding. It's parenting.
beats.img: a tiny cartoon ostrich far away on the horizon with its head down, seen through binoculars

beats.say: And when an ostrich is in real danger, it does the reasonable thing. It runs at about seventy kilometers an hour, or it kicks hard enough to seriously hurt a lion.
beats.img: a cartoon ostrich running extremely fast with speed lines and a dust cloud

beats.say: Next. The goldfish with a three second memory. People love this one, because it makes them feel better about forgetting why they walked into the kitchen.
beats.img: a confused cartoon man standing in a kitchen scratching his head

beats.say: It's completely wrong.
beats.img: a smug cartoon goldfish wearing tiny sunglasses in a fishbowl

beats.say: Researchers have trained goldfish to push levers for food, to react to sounds, and to show up at a certain spot at feeding time. And they remember these tricks for months.
beats.img: a cartoon goldfish pushing a small red lever inside an aquarium

beats.say: So your goldfish isn't forgetting you every three seconds. It remembers you just fine. It just doesn't care.
beats.img: a cartoon goldfish turning its back on a person waving at the fishbowl

beats.say: Now, bulls and the color red.
beats.img: a cartoon bull facing a red cape held by a matador

beats.say: The matador waves a red cape, the bull charges, so obviously the bull hates red. Except bulls can't really see red the way we do.
beats.img: a cartoon bull charging forward with steam coming out of its nose

beats.say: Cattle have two color vision, so to a bull, that bright red cape looks more like a dull, muddy brown.
beats.img: a cartoon bull looking at a dull grey brown cape, unimpressed

beats.say: What actually makes the bull charge is the movement. Wave a blue cape, a green cape, or your grandma's tablecloth, and you'll get the exact same result.
beats.img: a cartoon bull chasing a flying flowery tablecloth

beats.say: The red is for the crowd. It's not science. It's show business.
beats.img: a cartoon cheering crowd in a stadium throwing roses

beats.say: And blind as a bat? Bats are not blind. Not a single species.
beats.img: a cartoon bat hanging upside down with big open eyes

beats.say: Lots of bats use echolocation, but they can still see. And big fruit bats barely echolocate at all. They get around with sharp eyes and a great nose.
beats.img: a cartoon fruit bat holding a banana and smiling

beats.say: So really, the saying should be blind as a guy looking for the glasses that are on his head.
beats.img: a cartoon man searching for his glasses while they sit on top of his head

beats.say: And we're just getting started, because the next one involves Disney, a cliff, and a very fake documentary.
beats.img: a cartoon old film camera on a tripod pointed at a rocky cliff with small furry rodents
